title: Queens Gambit
tagline: This project uses superfluid streaming payments to make a NFT piggy bank with incentives for saving. This app lets creators bundle their NFTs into savings accounts and they can share them with their fans.

how_its_made:
We used Hardhat to author our smart contracts. We integrated superfluid streaming payments to do the deposit into our contracts. Corgi images from cryptocorgis.co. We built our contracts with solidity and tested using mocha and Hardhat.
